title: helper2 back office
description: helper2.ai back office (application="helper2-backoffice"): the Scout and its collectors, enrichment and its daily budgets, the embedding indexer, the review queue, the admin pages. The public app: dashboard helper2. Meters: ADR 0009.

panels.title: Scout
panels.description: 1 = the Scout runs on this environment (backoffice.scoutEnabled). Off on staging except for a rehearsal.

panels.title: Stalest Scout source
panels.description: Age of the oldest last-success among Scout sources. Empty on staging (Scout off).

panels.title: Enrichment budget left
panels.description: Enrichment model calls left today (UTC day, H2_SCOUT_DAILY_ENRICHMENT_CALLS).

panels.title: Embedding backlog
panels.description: Resources waiting for a vector (the indexer embeds about 12 a minute; no value until its first batch after a start).

panels.title: Since last embedding batch
panels.description: Helper2EmbeddingIndexerStalled fires at 30 minutes.

panels.title: Open review items
panels.description: Review items waiting for a decision; Helper2ReviewBacklog fires above 50 for a day.

panels.title: Time since last success
panels.description: Collector intervals differ (15 min to 7 days); compare with each source's interval. Empty while the Scout is off.

panels.title: Runs by status
panels.description: Empty while the Scout is off (backoffice.scoutEnabled).

panels.title: Items by source
panels.description: What each collector brought in (helper2.scout.items).

panels.title: Enrichments skipped as UNCHANGED
panels.description: Resources whose source text is the same as at their last successful enrichment: no model call. Compared with the enrichments that did call the model.

panels.title: UNCHANGED share of enrichments (1h)
panels.description: Share of enrichment attempts skipped because the source text did not change.

panels.title: Model budgets left today
panels.description: Calls left under each daily cap (UTC day). Helper2BackofficeBudgetLow fires below 20%.

panels.title: Page reads left today (evidence step)
panels.description: Tavily Extract credits left for product pages (H2_SCOUT_PAGE_READER_DAILY_CREDITS).

panels.title: Tavily credits by feature (Scout)
panels.description: The Scout's Tavily credits; they count on the plan with the public app's (Helper2LiveWebCreditsHigh adds both).

panels.title: Model call p95 by step
panels.description: Enrichment, gap, classifier, event reader and example drafts.

panels.title: Embedding backlog
panels.description: Resources without a vector for the embedding model, read after each indexer batch. Empty without H2_NVIDIA_API_KEY (indexer off).

panels.title: Embedding failures by reason
panels.description: Failed indexer batches; the next batch retries the same resources.

panels.title: Time since last embedding batch
panels.description: Seconds since the indexer last stored a batch. It grows while the backlog is empty, which is fine; with a backlog it means the indexer is stuck.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application="helper2-backoffice",environment="$environment",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: 1 = Alloy reaches the management port (8081). 0 or empty: pod down, or the NetworkPolicy blocks the observability namespace.

panels.title: Container memory vs limit
panels.description: The limit is 1Gi: the JVM heap plus metaspace, threads and buffers must fit, or the kernel OOM-kills the pod.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: From the structured (logstash JSON) app log, shipped by the cluster Alloy.
